## Security
- **Other websites can no longer drive ArrHub through your browser.** Until now a page you visited could quietly send a POST to ArrHub (restart or update a container, change settings, delete images) or open the container terminal over a WebSocket, because the browser attached your login. Every POST and the terminal now have to come from ArrHub's own page: the browser's `Origin` must match the address ArrHub is opened on (`Host` or `X-Forwarded-Host`, so Nginx Proxy Manager works as is), and browser POSTs must be JSON. Scripts without an `Origin` header (curl) still work. To call the API from another page of your own, list it in `ARRHUB_ORIGINS`.
- **Docker control needs a login.** Docker control can run anything on the Docker host, so with a Docker address set and no ArrHub login the Docker features are locked, with a message saying how to unlock them. If an Access List in Nginx Proxy Manager (or another reverse proxy) already asks for a password in front of ArrHub, tick the new *Login is handled by my reverse proxy* under Settings → Docker, or set `ARRHUB_DOCKER_NOAUTH=true`.
- The ArrHub password is now compared in constant time.

## Upgrade

> **Using Docker control without an ArrHub login?** After the upgrade, set a login in Settings → *ArrHub login*, or tick *Login is handled by my reverse proxy* under Settings → Docker if your proxy already asks for one.

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.21.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Manual install:** copy `lib/` too (`cp -r server.js compose.js package.json lib public /opt/arrhub/`).

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.20.1...v1.21.0
